blocks.html:
Van Decals

Vinyl Wrap Toronto decaled Home Free’s first Nissan van a month ago. They bought another Nissan NV200 and asked us to repeat the van decals on the new vehicle. Our Graphics team did a quick check to ensure the vehicles were the same size. This was to ensure no major changes from the new 2020 model to the 2018 model they just bought. We fitted this Nissan van decals job in the middle of wrapping another car and full boat wrap. This is the time of the year that people decide to wrap their cars or recreational equipment before the summer. Our installation team worked off their previous instructions and the application of the vinyl was quick and easy.
Once the final design was approved by the owners, the vinyl was printed and cut. Before our installation team asked for the vehicle, the vinyl needed 48 hours for degassing after printing.

The process of getting the vinyl-ready can take 3 days from start to finish in most cases.
The simplicity of having the company name or logo on the vehicle helps to attract business. For Home Free, it was decals on either side and the back. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has found advertising on a vehicle to be one of the cheapest forms of advertising.
Vinyl Wrap Toronto took this Nissan van and added decals for Home Free Pest Removal to transform a standard vehicle into a moving advertising board for the company.
